skills.name: hacking
skills.description: Master attack playbook: you are an attacker. Recon, service exploitation, web attacks, command-line attacks (curl/powershell/nmap-style), Windows & Active Directory attacks, webshells & reverse shells, privilege escalation, CTF flag hunting. Read this for EVERY security/hacking task.

skills.name: osint
skills.description: Open source intelligence: domain/infra mapping, people tracking, GitHub/breach pivoting, reverse image search, username enumeration, company intel. Read for ANY intelligence gathering task.

skills.name: cracking
skills.description: Password & hash cracking: hash identification, hashcat/john usage, masks, rules & combinator tricks, Kerberoast/AS-REP hashes, encrypted file recovery (zip/pdf/office/keepass/gpg/veracrypt), online credential attacks.

skills.name: exploit-dev
skills.description: Binary exploitation: buffer overflows, format strings, heap attacks, ROP, shellcode, mitigations bypass (NX/ASLR/canary/PIE), Windows exploit dev (SEH/egghunters), pwntools + gdb workflow, CTF remote exploitation.

skills.name: crypto-attacks
skills.description: Cryptography attacks: encoding/cipher identification, RSA attack classes (small e, Wiener, common modulus, padding oracle), ECB/CBC/CTR attacks, hash length extension, nonce reuse, PRNG prediction.

skills.name: reverse-engineering
skills.description: Reverse engineering: file identification, strings hunting, disassembly, key/flag extraction, packing/obfuscation bypass, dynamic analysis with strace/ltrace/gdb, firmware analysis.

skills.name: wifi
skills.description: Wireless attacks: monitor mode setup, airodump/aircrack, WPA/WPA2 handshake + PMKID cracking, WPS attacks, evil twin (hostapd/wifiphisher), WPA-EAP attacks.

skills.name: steganography
skills.description: Hidden data extraction & hiding: LSB analysis, strings/exiftool/binwalk first pass, spectrogram/SSTV audio, video frame analysis, data embedding for exfiltration.

skills.name: forensics
skills.description: Digital forensics: disk image analysis (Sleuth Kit/Autopsy), memory forensics (Volatility), Windows artifacts (registry/prefetch/LNK/PS history/recycle bin), file carving (PhotoRec/foremost).

skills.name: post-exploitation
skills.description: Post-exploitation: privilege escalation, credential harvesting (mimikatz/secretsdump/DPAPI), lateral movement (pass-the-hash, WMI/SMB, kerberos), pivoting/tunneling (chisel/socat/ssh), persistence, exfiltration.

skills.name: evasion
skills.description: AV/EDR evasion: payload obfuscation, in-memory execution, AMSI bypass, process injection, living off the land (LOLBins), behavioral evasion, static signature avoidance.

skills.name: social-engineering
skills.description: Social engineering: phishing email craft, spoofing/DMARC, fake login harvesting pages (Gophish/SET/Evilginx), payload delivery (macros/HTA/HTML smuggling), vishing pretexts.

skills.name: api-hacking
skills.description: API pentesting: REST/GraphQL discovery (swagger/introspection), auth & JWT attacks, IDOR & mass assignment, NoSQL/SQL injection in APIs, GraphQL batching attacks, mobile backend attacks.

skills.name: cloud-attacks
skills.description: Cloud attacks: S3/Azure/GCS bucket enumeration & write access, cloud metadata service SSRF (AWS/GCP/Azure keys), stolen cloud key abuse, Terraform state leaks, Kubernetes/Docker registry misconfigs.

skills.name: database-attacks
skills.description: Database attacks: unauthenticated Redis/MongoDB/Elasticsearch/Memcached/CouchDB, default creds (MySQL/Postgres/MSSQL/Oracle), Redis RCE via CONFIG SET, SQL injection escalation (xp_cmdshell/INTO OUTFILE), NoSQL injection.

skills.name: mobile-hacking
skills.description: Mobile app hacking: APK/IPA analysis, manifest & decompile (jadx/apktool), hardcoded secrets & Firebase dumps, Frida dynamic analysis & SSL pinning bypass, adb data extraction, backend API attacks.

skills.name: hardware-hacking
skills.description: Hardware hacking: embedded device recon (FCC ID, board analysis), UART/JTAG/SWD/SPI interfaces, firmware extraction (binwalk/openocd/flashrom), firmware analysis & decryption, runtime attacks on routers/IoT, MIFARE/NFC attacks.

skills.name: scada-ics
skills.description: SCADA/ICS attacks: OT recon, Modbus/S7comm/DNP3/IEC104/EtherNet-IP/BACnet/OPC UA protocol attacks, engineering station attacks (TIA Portal/WinCC/Studio 5000 project cracking), PLC code exfil & logic persistence, replay attacks.

skills.name: game-hacking
skills.description: Game hacking: Cheat Engine memory scanning & pointer chains, trainer development (pymem/frida/CE AOB), save file editing (binary/compressed/checksummed), local asset mods, game server & API exploitation.

skills.name: malware-analysis
skills.description: Malware analysis: triage (hashes/VT/strings/capa), static analysis of PE/ELF/.NET/Go (imports, dnSpy, UPX unpacking), dynamic sandbox analysis (Procmon/Regshot/x64dbg), C2 & config extraction (tokens, keys, exfil endpoints).

skills.name: web-attacks
skills.description: Advanced web attacks: SSTI (Jinja2/Twig/Freemarker), XXE/XInclude & blind XXE, SSRF with filter bypasses + cloud metadata, insecure deserialization (PHP/Java/Python/.NET/Node), file upload bypasses, HTTP request smuggling, CSRF/clickjacking.

skills.name: network-attacks
skills.description: Network attacks: ARP spoofing & MITM, rogue DHCP, VLAN hopping (double tagging/DTP), DNS/ICMP spoofing, WPAD hijack, LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning with responder, NTLM relay, session hijacking, LAN enumeration & pivoting.

skills.name: blockchain-web3
skills.description: Blockchain & Web3 hacking: smart contract recon (Etherscan/ABI/decompilation), Solidity vulns (reentrancy, overflow, access control, front-running, oracle manipulation), foundry exploit workflow with mainnet forks, wallet/private key attacks, DeFi & bridge exploits.

skills.name: vulnerability-research
skills.description: Vulnerability research: CVE hunting & patch diffing, fuzzing with AFL++/libFuzzer/honggfuzz (harnesses, dictionaries, ASAN), crash triage (gdb/rr/ASAN classification), PoC minimization & development, disclosure.

skills.name: packet-analysis
skills.description: Packet analysis: pcap overview (capinfos/tshark statistics), protocol dissection (HTTP/FTP/SMTP/Telnet/NTLM/Kerberos/DNS/SMB), credential hunting, file & object extraction (tshark export/foremost/tcpflow), anomaly detection (tunneling, beaconing, ARP poisoning).
